info.title: Fleet enrollment API
info.description: Enrollment lab with bootstrap redemption, administrator provisioning, HTTPS mTLS device identity and durable command-event ingestion. Runtime verification is distinct from schema validation. Production CA, browser login, production MQTT transport and full revocation lifecycle remain outside this lab.

post.summary: Commit one owned command event and recover its original acknowledgement
post.description: HTTPS only, using the enrolled device certificate policy. Bootstrap/API bearer tokens and forwarded certificate headers are not credentials. Accept one unencoded UTF-8 application/json event, at most 8192 bytes including whitespace; reject duplicate/unknown fields and device mismatch. Check trusted command/correlation ownership and fresh completed/enabled enrollment under a PostgreSQL row lock. Commit event and original acknowledgement together before returning 200; identical duplicate delivery returns exactly the original acknowledgement JSON and receivedAt. UUID casing, property order and equivalent numeric version forms normalize; timestamp text remains significant, so rewriting an equivalent timestamp conflicts. A disabled device normally receives 401 at authentication; disable committed between authentication and ingestion is a generic 409. Ownership, correlation and changed-content/event-ID rejection also use the same generic 409. No command registration route or execution/lifecycle projection is provided. Requests share the device identity route's process-local 120-per-minute limit, including unauthorized requests. Ingestion has a cooperative 15-second deadline after the separate authentication deadline. An uncertain commit/lost reply must be retried with the original event; HTTP failure never grants permission to delete the Android outbox event.

200.description: Committed original acknowledgement, for either first ingestion or identical replay. This is not command execution success.

401.description: Missing, unregistered or disabled device certificate; no bearer challenge.

409.description: Generic event ownership, identity or current enrollment rejection, without exposing existing event or command contents.

413.description: Request exceeds 8192 bytes, including requests without Content-Length.

415.description: Only unencoded application/json with optional UTF-8 charset is accepted.

get.summary: Read the identity authenticated by the device TLS certificate
get.description: HTTPS only. Requires TLS proof of the enrolled private key, pinned device CA, valid P-256/SHA256 certificate with exact clientAuth usage and one device URI SAN, and exact certificate/key membership in a completed enrollment. Server validation is not hardware-key attestation. DeviceAccessDisabled is checked from PostgreSQL on every request, without a positive identity cache. Bootstrap/API access tokens and forwarded certificate headers are not device credentials. Invalid certificate chains may fail at TLS before an HTTP response. Shared process-local limit: 120 requests per minute, including unauthorized requests. No MQTT authentication, CRL/OCSP or active-connection termination is implied.

200.description: Authenticated server-assigned device identity; no credential or private material returned.

401.description: No certificate, unregistered certificate or disabled device identity. No bootstrap bearer challenge is issued.

post.summary: Create a pending enrollment and deliver its bootstrap token once
post.description: HTTPS only. Requires an at+jwt access token with validated OIDC issuer, API audience, lifetime and RS256/ES256 signature, one subject, and exact permission claim enrollments:create. Enforce a 1024-byte JSON body limit and reject duplicate/unknown keys. Commit the pending credential digest and issuer/subject audit together before returning the secret. Never log or store the plaintext response. No retrieval or idempotent replay is provided: a lost response leaves an expiring orphan, and retrying creates another enrollment. Process-local shared limit: ten requests per minute including unauthorized requests. Live external identity-provider integration is not established by local signed-token tests.

201.description: Pending enrollment and administrator audit committed; sensitive bootstrap token is delivered only in this response.

401.description: Missing or invalid administrator access token.

403.description: Authenticated principal lacks the exact permission or required issuer/subject binding.

415.description: Only unencoded UTF-8 application/json is accepted.

post.summary: Redeem a pending enrollment for a server-assigned device identity
post.description: Requires server-authenticated TLS and a short-lived one-use bearer token bound to pendingEnrollmentId. This bootstrap route does not require an existing device certificate. Enforce a 24576-byte request-body limit before JSON parsing. Validate base64 DER PKCS#10, proof-of-possession signature and P-256/SHA-256 key policy before issuance. Ignore requested CSR subject/SAN identities and derive identity from the server-assigned device ID. A successful response must follow durable enrollment completion. A concurrent or later byte-identical CSR retry with the original token may retrieve the same persisted response until the original token expires, without issuing a new certificate, identity or extending expiry. A different CSR for an already completed enrollment conflicts. Expired, invalid or wrongly bound tokens return the same generic 401. These are required server semantics, not behavior guaranteed by OpenAPI validation.

201.description: New enrollment durably completed; immutable device identity and certificate response persisted before sending.

200.description: Exact CSR retry returns the original durable response, with unchanged identity, certificate and timestamps. Original token must still be within its initial lifetime.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or wrongly bound bootstrap credential. Do not disclose enrollment existence or token state.

409.description: Authenticated pending enrollment is already completed for a different CSR, revoked, or requires administrator recovery. No replacement identity or credential is issued.

429.description: Bootstrap rate limit reached. Rate limits apply before expensive CSR verification and issuance, including invalid credentials.

503.description: Durable enrollment completion is unavailable. Retry the same request; never mint another identity to recover an uncertain operation.

administratorAccessToken.description: OIDC authority-issued at+jwt API access token with enrollments:create permission; not an ID token, device certificate or opaque bootstrap secret. Configure the trusted HTTPS authority and dedicated API audience out of band.

enrollmentToken.description: Opaque cryptographically random bootstrap credential, not a JWT or console session. Store only a keyed digest server-side; never log it or put it in a URL/body. Bound to a pending enrollment and initial expiry. Consumption permits no new issuance on replay; only exact response recovery while initially valid.

deviceCertificate.description: The HTTPS device identity route requires a valid pinned-CA certificate, TLS key-possession proof, exact completed-enrollment membership and an enabled device record. Forwarded certificate headers are not trusted. CRL/OCSP, MQTT access and full certificate-revocation lifecycle remain unimplemented.

RetryUnavailable.description: Rate limited or temporarily unavailable. Retrying creation may create another enrollment if the original commit succeeded but delivery failed; do not treat this operation as idempotent.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed JSON, duplicate keys, schema/encoding error, invalid CSR signature or unsupported key. Return only a generic title and optional opaque trace ID.

InternalError.description: Unexpected failure; no exception details, CSR contents, credentials or enrollment existence disclosed.
